03579 Kozbiy {koz-bee'}

源自 03576; 陰性專有名詞

AV - Cozbi 2; 2

哥斯比 
1) 米甸人首領蘇珥的女兒, 因為通姦而被非尼哈所殺 (#民 25:15,18|)
record.edic_text:
03579 Kozbiy {koz-bee'}

from 03576;; n pr f

AV - Cozbi 2; 2

Cozbi = "my lie"
1) a daughter of Zur, a chief of the Midianites, who was slain by
   Phinehas because of her adultery
